name: mark_subtask_as_completed
description: Mark one existing subtask of a Sunsama task as complete, identified by its parent task id and subtask id. WRITE - this changes state the user and their teammates see. Use it only when the user explicitly said that specific subtask is done; do not use it to complete the parent task, to complete several subtasks inferred from a general remark such as 'I finished that', or for tasks in any other app. It cannot un-complete a subtask.

taskId.description: The ID of the parent task
